result.title: Hierarchical Multimodal Interaction Reasoning for Dyadic Relationship Recognition
result.summary: Dyadic relationship recognition aims to identify the latent social relationship between two individuals from their multimodal interactions. Existing methods typically project heterogeneous cues into a shared representation and optimise a flat classification objective, overlooking that relationships may rely on different interaction patterns. For instance, distant relationships can often be inferred from direct behavioural correspondence, whereas close relationships are better reflected by coordinated affective, behavioural, and multimodal responses. To address this limitation, we propose HiRe-DRR, a Hierarchical Multimodal Interaction Reasoning framework that organises relationship evidence from three complementary perspectives: feature level, interaction type, and relationship hierarchy. HiRe-DRR decomposes facial, bodily, acoustic, and textual cues into low- and high-level representations and constructs homogeneous and heterogeneous cross-participant interactions. We further introduce the Mixture-of-Interaction Transformer (MoI-Former), which treats diverse interactions as specialised experts and employs relation-aware sparse routing to identify relationship-relevant evidence while preserving contextual interaction information. The proposed Hierarchical Conditional Loss (HC-Loss) exploits the hierarchical nature of social relationships through coarse-to-fine supervision, enabling structured relationship reasoning. Extensive experiments on three dyadic relationship benchmarks demonstrate that HiRe-DRR outperforms recent representative image-, video-, and multimodal methods. Our routing analysis further reveals that distant relationships tend to rely on low-level homogeneous interactions, whereas closer relationships focus on high-level heterogeneous interactions. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/tw-repository/HiRe-DRR.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 HiRe-DRR 层次多模态交互推理框架，将面部、身体、语音与文本线索分解为低/高层表示并构建跨参与者的同质与异质交互，再用 MoI-Former 的稀疏专家路由和层次条件损失识别二人社会关系。
AI.relevance_reason: 把多种交互视为专家并用关系感知稀疏路由筛选相关证据，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与模块化状态更新提供可核查线索；但任务是关系分类、不涉及 latent 推理状态生成，迁移性需核查。
